contract.purpose: Route appropriate shell, build, lint, and test commands through RTK while preserving Reasonix safety gates and command semantics.
contract.scope: Detect RTK, rewrite eligible shell commands, allow raw bypass, preserve exit code, surface savings telemetry, and report health in doctor/dashboard.

invariants.invariant-1: Approval prompts display the effective command, including RTK rewrite.
invariants.invariant-2: Exit codes and failure behavior must match raw command execution.
invariants.invariant-3: Users can bypass filtering with an explicit raw mode.
